art_direction: 青绿气态行星表面有卷曲风暴与奶白云带，背后细环被边光照亮。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create a jade-green gas giant with broad cream cloud bands and one spiraling storm near its central lower region. View it from a slight angle so the atmosphere curves convincingly around the sphere. A narrow dusty ring passes behind the planet and catches a faint rim light. Use deep navy space with a few small stars and no other large objects. Keep the planet dominant at thumbnail scale, while layered cloud wisps, storm turbulence, and a thin atmospheric edge provide detailed structure close up. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
